items.title: Specification vs. Prompt: What’s the Difference?
items.summary: A detailed prompt can help an AI coding agent complete a task—but a specification does much more. It captures the durable intent behind a project, including its goals, requirements, constraints, expected behaviors, and success criteria. Hari Krishnan, author of Spec-Driven Development, explains why specifications provide a shared source of truth that teams can review, refine, test, and maintain as software evolves—rather than temporary instructions for a single AI interaction. Learn more about Spec-Driven Development: https://hubs.la/Q04ypXVz0 #SpecDrivenDevelopment #PromptEngineering #AICoding #ContextEngineering #CodingAgents #Shorts

items.title: Top AI for the Art. Cheap AI for the Code.
items.summary: In episode 1031 of the SuperDataScience podcast, Jon Krohn discusses with Ish Shah, Director at Dell how different AI models are suited for different tasks, highlighting the "jagged frontier" of AI. He explains that top-tier models are essential for high-quality artwork, while simpler, more cost-effective models suffice for coding tasks. This approach optimizes resource use by matching model complexity to specific needs.
